scope: AlmaLinux 10 PCRE2 10.44 x86_64 JIT vector suffix scan for QUnit script-name pattern \.qm$.
root_cause: QUnit tests the script path against \.qm$. GDB stops in generated SSE pcmpeqb/pmovmskb code: its first branch inspects bytes past the logical subject end, before subsequent bounds validation discards those candidate positions. The script-name allocation has undefined spare capacity. A standalone PCRE2 program reproduces the reports without Qore or ODBC.

proof.subject: /fixture/module-odbc/test/array-binding.qtest
proof.dimensions: 16 alignments x 256 padding values x positive/negative suffix
proof.undefined_padding: All results correct, all 25 allocations freed; Valgrind reports the same generated-code branch family.
proof.defined_padding: Every possible byte value in spare capacity gives the same expected results; Valgrind zero errors and all allocations freed.
proof.qore_control: 10,000 regex iterations reproduce the site independently of ODBC.
proof.odbc_functional: Final tests: 28 array cases/55 assertions, eight existing cases/99 assertions, and one native fault-injection case/two assertions pass on Fedora, Leap and AlmaLinux; 12 native buffer-size boundary cases also pass.
